correctness.rationale: For the exact finite standard Fourier mode, Jucys–Murphy content energies and character orthogonality yield a triple-character Kronecker sum. Standard permutation representation Ind(1)−1 and multiplicity-free branching give g_{λμ,std}=∑ν 1_{ν↗λ}1_{ν↗μ}−δλμ; regrouping yields n/(n−1) E_Plancherel |Φ|²−1/(n−1). Dissipative central transposition convolution contributes e^{-2γt/(n−1)}. Kerov/Romik–Śniady Thm3.2, with limit shape concentration and continuity of the conditional transition measure, yields weak-in-probability semicircle; its characteristic function at 2s is J1(4s)/(2s); bounded Φ yields Bessel square and weak γ_n=g/√n factor. Independent permutation-space Hamiltonian exponentiation n=2..5 at four nonzero times matched finite branching formula to 1e−10, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: The limit is pointwise fixed scaled s and only one Fourier mode, not total variation/cutoff; full recent preprint unavailable.
